1636973796929437696 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 49 🔁 5
what is deviant for an individual in relation to a wider social norm, can be the norm within a specific context. culture-work is significantly about selecting and encouraging the 'right' (subjective, ofc) deviances
↓
1636974152409300992 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 17
i've been talking about this stuff for years and years but lately it's been converging into remarkably simple clarity for me. there's like a "deviance theory of everything" in here lol. you can do like a "cultural startup" to find some healthy/good deviance,
↓
1636974630153097216 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 11
and if you find something that's effective, and benefits the larger social body, then you will be rewarded for it. 

you could plot a graph of "how much do people in some context care about experimenting with this stuff". the founding of the USA was a peak https://t.co/pWrf3sllmR
  [Quoting @visakanv: Every group of friends incubates a nascent society. 99.999% of them fail to do anything with it. once in a few hundred years a bunch of bloggers and nerds create something like The United States]
↓
1636974954414772225 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 19 🔁 1
"incubates a nascent society" = establishes a context with its own norms, which may or may not be deviant from wider norms

this is also what scenes are about. and also "all happy families..."

its all the same thing at different scales/intensity https://t.co/J0GWGcmfLW
  [Quoting @visakanv: one of my recurring talking points to anybody who's willing to listen:   any small group of people loosely-but-truly aligned on something can create powerful vectors by producing public-facing work that's directed at each other  talking about the creation of scenes, basically]
↓
1636975206236581889 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 25 🔁 2
"encouraging/positive QT culture" is a healthy-positive deviance that is valuable cultural dna in this part of twitter. elsewhere people assume that QTs are used primarily for dunking and insulting people. preaching to the choir here but clearly our way is better, lol
↓
1636975445949419521 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 17
and my argument is that it's not just better in some "i like this painting better than that painting" subjective way. I mean that positive QTs incubate high-trust scenius, which increases rate of specialization and trade, which is how all wealth is created https://t.co/QCM7vr3rzW
  [Quoting @visakanv: if we play our cards right https://t.co/65KsVIYWuC]
↓
1636975887483805696 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 29 🔁 1 [(SEED) type=quote_of_root]
an answer to "my country is a low-trust environment :(" is to start with incubating a high-trust environment amongst a group of peers. if you do it well, you will "string up the hammock" in a way that allows more people to join and enjoy the benefits https://t.co/sgOaMFvbP3
  [Quoting @RichDecibels: @embryosophy @visakanv @liminal_warmth @MasterTimBlais @myceliummage when I do this with one of my favourite co-facilitators we call it stringing up the hammock: the vibe between us two can hold many many more]
↓
1636976794741112838 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 14
i've come to believe that it's necessary to be somewhat oblique and illegible about these endeavors so that you can keep the ratios right. there may be other ways to do it but i think they're costlier and likelier to lead to hug-of-deaths  https://t.co/tYHl9zhdgq
  [Quoting @visakanv: if you have too many people who need help, and not enough people who can help, you end up with a group hug of death. and this limits the number of people you can help, by killing your operation before it gets to grow]
↓
1636977364436672512 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 15
there's also a yin/yang balance that's necessary for these culture-startups to succeed without either fading out or self-destructing, and often the optimists who start them are a little too eager/excited and don't think very much about all the ways in which things can go wrong
↓
1636977686810886145 [2023-03-18] @visakanv 💜 16
😎 and we're just getting started https://t.co/qkss8kX5yN
  [Quoting Tweet 1636977362976866306 (missing)]
